It's called Rideshare "Stimulator" (I should note those quotation marks are a part of the title), and it is essentially a game all about being an Uber driver for a city full of oddballs.
 
Read more
articles.title: Rideshare "Stimulator" is an Uber driver sim set in a city full of weirdos that I'm hoping is satirical enough to pull the concept off

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
There is an obvious humour to be found in the contrast between the visual presentation of Mario Party and the agita and unbridled rage it brings out in people. This is not a game about violence, yet it pulls it out from people nonetheless. So, how about something that leans into this violence, while still retaining the jovially competitive nature? Enter Machine Party, the latest from Buckshot Roulette developer Mike Klubnika, made alongside GDeavid, a party game "where failure is lethal."
 
Read more
articles.title: Machine Party, out now, is masochistic Mario Party from the dev that brought you Buckshot Roulette

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Skills in RuneScape have always tickled me because of the sheer variety on display, and this extends to Dragonwilds too. There's magic, but then there's woodcutting. You've got prayer, and also fishing. And of course you've got runecrafting, or agility. It's that last one that's important for today's purposes, as a new update has arrived in Dragonwilds that revamp the skill, as well as add in some courses for you to pseudo-parkour across.
 
Read more
articles.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds revamps the agility skill and gives you Wipeout style courses to test your mettle on

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Hark! I bring word of some good news for those of you with an appetite for adventure games with tasty pixel art. You may remember that Monkey Island creator Ron Gilbert was working on a game that was described as "Classic Zelda meets Diablo meets Thimbleweed Park." That got canned at the end of last year, unfortunately, but the spirit of Thimbleweed Park lives on. Literally! As Thimbleweed Park 2 is in the works.
 
Read more
articles.title: Thimbleweed Park 2 is "not really a sequel, not really a prequel," but it is in development and due out in 2028

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
In Dawn of War 4, each faction can field a massive endgame unit that basically dwarfs everything else on the battlefield. For instance, the machine-loving techpriests of the Adeptus Mechanicus, they can airdrop a multistory tall mech from space. This Titan will then merrily stomp around the battlefield crushing everything in its way. However, of all the factions, the Necrons – Games Workshop's equivalent of The Terminator – can bring to bear the most powerful. Called a C'Tan Shard of the Void Dragon, this spearwielding megaunit is a machine-bound fragment of a shattered god.
Unlike the other faction's endgame units, which reserve their rage for the enemy, the Necron's big unit has as much hate for its masters as it does its enemies.
Read more
articles.title: Your most powerful Necron unit in Dawn of War 4 is a sentient shard of a dead star god, and boy does he hate you

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
After tease upon tease upon tease, Helldivers 2's Warhammer 40k crossover warbond will finally arrive on August 12th. If you splash out for it, you'll get a box of gear, stratagems and cosmetics inspired by the Astra Militarum's elite Cadian Kasrkin troops.
Read more
articles.title: Helldivers 2's Warhammer 40k warbond finally gets a release date, will let you bust out the meltaguns and meltamines

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Before friendslop, there was friendgolf. Sorry, Golf With Your Friends. Released in early access in 2016, Blacklight Interactive’s devilishly competitive crazy golf sim ended up joining Among Us as a Covid lockdown darling, allowing those of us bored with pretending not to betray and victimise our oldest chums on spaceships to do so openly, on cartoon golfing greens. Now Golf With Your Friends 2 is in the works, at Golf 1’s DLC developers Radical Forge, and it sounds like it wants to ensnare you and your mates in a series of club-and-ball arguments for eternity.
Read more
articles.title: To escalate its relationship-straining putting contests, Golf With Your Friends 2 is turning to chaos and custom courses

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Update: Exactly two minutes after publishing, I noticed that Halo - Chipmunk Edition's creator has AI-generated music videos on their YouTube channel. Laugh rescinded pending further evidence. Beware that searching for Halo: Campaign Evolved mods is very much a game of avoid/try to spot the AI use at the moment for those averse to the tech.
Original story follows:
Halo: Campaign Evolved's now it's out in full, so naturally the mods are flowing. In taking a look through the early ones, which include the usual sorts of performance a graphical tweaks which crop up for every new release, I've stumbled across a few works I'd class as pulling off interesting or noteworthy stuff thus far. There's a mod which purports to activate split-screen co-op the devs have left sitting behind the scenes and another which swaps Cortana's lines for ones from the original Combat Evolved. Both of those have been made using AI - Claude in one case, OpenAI Codex in the other.
So, I tried digging a bit deeper into the early combat mods which don't have any AI shoutouts in their descriptions. That's led me to Halo - Chipmunk Edition.
Read more
articles.title: Halo on helium has arrived less than a week after modders got their hands on Campaign Evolved, though AI might've been used to chipmunk Chief and Cortana

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Efforts by those now running Xbox to convince onlookers that the gaming division of Microsoft is now in a better place to start hauling in the ever-growing money numbers those overseeing it crave have continued alongside Microsoft first financial report since this month's mass layoffs. Both Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and her boss Satya Nadella have declared they're looking for the division to be growing financially again by about this time next year.
Read more
articles.title: "Our business did not grow with our audience": post-layoffs, Xbox execs are trying to sell a gaming division bounce back by summer 2027

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
BeamNG.drive's long been one of the easiest games to reccomend to a car lover cruising the streets of Steam. As Graham wrote in 2017, it's a moddable sandbox dedicated to vehicular destruction physics, in which every bump, crumple, and slam results in a glorious bending of metal and smashing of glass. BeamNG's been growing via updates for ages, and its devs say the latest is the biggest yet.
Read more
articles.title: BeamNG.drive, Steam's finest car pancake maker, gets its biggest update yet with overhauled graphics, fresh rally stages and a sporty new coupe

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
I’d put my six-pounder anti-tank guns in the perfect position to halt the Tigers’ advance. The German tanks would have to cross the bridge, keeping them packed together, and the derailed train on their flank would keep them from spreading out too much before they came into range of my British gunners’ heavy ordnance.
Being the twelfth and last wave of this game of Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand, if I could put down the tanks' advance I'd win the match and take home a healthy bushel of perk points to upgrade my faction for future matches.
But then the blasted Luftwaffe arrived.
Read more
articles.title: I'm not going to 100% roguelite strategy spinoff Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand, but it does breathe new life into some of the series' oldest features

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Kaboom! A trailer has just landed in your inbox, blasting your laptop apart in a sputter of copper and fossilised breadcrumbs. You scan the horizon desperately with your binoculars, but there is no sign of the aggressor. Then: kablam! An incendiary press release whistles into the wreckage of your computer. You unscrunch it with smouldering fingers, and read the words: the first public playtest for Tyr is underway, running till 2nd August.


What is Tyr? Kablooie! A high-explosive Steam page link reduces what remains of your PC to atoms. Ah, I see: Tyr is a new multiplayer tank shooter from Stoke Games, a team of former League of Legends, Valorant, StarCraft 2, and Destiny 2 developers. In case I hadn't spelled things out enough, it puts a high price on visibility and reconnaissance. What you can't see can most definitely turn you into a crater. Here's that trailer.
 
Read more
articles.title: Stealth and armour placement rule supreme in Tyr, the new tank shooter from former Destiny and Valorant devs, with a public playtest now live

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Remember that paranormal, protagonist-juggling adventure game in the works at Studio Reset, an indie outfit formed by former Mass Effect/Dragon's Age staffers? It’s just been fully revealed as The Eventide, with a debut trailer to show off its watercoloured, reality-warping take on a neon-noir detective yarn.
Read more
articles.title: "The Case of the Golden Idol-style deduction meets The X-Files": Former BioWare devs unveil supernatural detective game The Eventide

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Subnautica 2 publishers Krafton may have had to pay Unknown Worlds a massive earn-out, after losing a farcical courtroom battle with ousted studio execs, but they're tickled pink by the ocean survival game's sales. According to Krafton's latest quarter-year financials, Subnautica 2 has sold over five million units since the early access launch.
They're now trumpeting its potential to become "our second franchise IP" after PUBG, in the words of head of investor relations Sophie Lee, which indicates that they're not only thinking about a possible Subnautica 3, but eyeing up Subnautica crossovers of all kinds. Think of the merchandising! Alterra lunchboxes! Reaper-branded cans of sardines! Nibbler Mango bodypillows! Maybe some kind of dastardly LLM-piloted luxury submarine!
 Read more
articles.title: Krafton have big plans for Subnautica, after the second game's once-divisive co-op "confirmed the potential to expand beyond the existing fan base"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
There's been a glut of horror-themed job sims lately, from 2025's atrocious smileorama Hellmart to the recent multiplayer offering Shift At Midnight, in which you try not to endorse the existence of any doppelgangers by accidentally selling them groceries. It's been fun, but friends, we have now gone too far.
 Read more
articles.title: Serve refreshments and spot demons in Night Plane, a PSX-style horror job sim about being a flight attendant in 1999

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Chinese soulslike Wuchang: Fallen Feathers is getting a sequel, set to be developed by a new studio helmed by the first game's director. Rather than original studio Lenzee, the new Wuchang entry's being made by Indolphinity - or the Chengdu Recursive Dolphin Technology Company - and published by 505 Games.
Read more
articles.title: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers sequel in the works from original director's new studio, which bears the wonderful name Indolphinity

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Former Dragon Age series producer Mark Darrah has shared his tuppence worth on the likelihood of BioWare and EA ever commissioning a full-on original Dragon Age trilogy remaster or remake. He thinks such a remastering or remakering would sell pretty well, not least because OG Dragon Age looks like a toilet bowl in a Silent Hill game (I exaggerate the sentiments here slightly). But he also thinks the odds of such a project are low, for the straightforward reason that nobody either inside or outside BioWare really understands the proprietary technology those older RPGs run on. Ah well. We'll always have the mods.
 Read more
articles.title: "Dragon Age: Origins wasn’t the most attractive game": BioWare's old series producer still thinks a DA remaster trilogy is worth it, but the knowhow isn't there

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
GTA Online players in Australia have reportedly found themselves suddenly barred from the litany of in-game gambling minigames found in Los Santos' Diamond Casino, with the change seemingly the result of developers Rockstar adding the country to their list of places where access to such minigames is restricted.
Read more
articles.title: GTA Online in-game gambling reportedly blocked in Australia, leaving folks down under locked out of Diamond Casino games

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
When you start to think about verbs in games, you start to realise how few of them are really at your disposal in most releases. There's only so many features a game can have after all, particularly a 3D one. But for Mike Bithell and his next game Vampirium: 1997, keeping things slim lets him put a new verb in without much hassle.
 
Read more
articles.title: "I genuinely think there's awesome potential": Mike Bithell on his "im-slim" Vampirium: 1997 and the power of quick verbs

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
It's another one of those days, as Double Fine have announced that they are laying off 23 members of staff. This comes weeks after their split from Xbox that left them independent once more, which also saw South of Midnight developers Compulsion go indie, and State of Decay studio Undead Labs and Senua's Ninja Theory acquired by new, as of yet to be confirmed owners.
 
Read more
articles.title: After gaining independence from Xbox, Double Fine are laying off a quarter of their staff

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
As someone that partially grew up by the seaside, I always kind of forget that there are plenty of city folk out there who just haven't experienced the beach. It's a tragedy! Or a blessing, depending on your tolerance for sunburns, and children covered in ice cream, and finding sand in places you didn't even know existed for days on end. So, how about a game that allows you to have a bit of fun in the sun where all you do is build sandcastles in a physics-accurate literal sandbox called (predictably) Sandcastle?
 
Read more
articles.title: Inviting beaches and delightful physics await you in literal sandbox game, Sandcastle

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Wizards of the Coast president John Hight is stepping down from the role. As reported by GamesIndustry.biz, a US Securities and Exchange Commission filing from July 27th revealed that Hight will be moving on from the role come September 1st. This doesn't mean he's leaving the company completely, as he'll be shifting into an advisor role. The change in role comes roughly two years after Hight took it in August 2024, and after WOTC owner Hasbro took a $56 million impairment charge last week.
 
Read more
articles.title: Two years on from taking the role, Wizards of the Coast's president is stepping down

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
On its surface, aesthetically Mistfall Hunter certainly looks like a game where if you were doomscrolling and briefly saw a gif of it in action, you'd be forgiven for thinking it's from Elden Ring. The game certainly apes FromSoftware's dark fantasy, selectively colourful vibe, but it is offering up something different under the hood at least, as rather than your dime a dozen soulslike, it's opted for the slightly trendier extraction approach.
 
Read more
articles.title: Mistfall Hunter looks like legally distinct Elden Ring but with a faster paced, extraction spin

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Last June, modding site Nexus Mods announced an ownership change. Site founder Robin 'Dark0ne' Scott stepped back, and in came a number of new leaders from Danish firm Chosen - principally Chosen CEO Victor Folmann. A year and a bit on from taking the reigns, Folmann's put up a post reflecting on the new regime's first year running the modding site and outlining hopes to turn it into "an operating system for user-generated content in gaming" in the long term.
Read more
articles.title: "I didn’t fully appreciate the scope of it": a year on from taking over, Nexus Mods owners reflect on the challenges of their push to minimise modding hassle

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Asymmetric shoes may not seem like a big deal. I mean, if we look past the cultural mountain that was climbed to turn the faux pas of odd socks into a proud fashion statement of mismatched shoes, asymmetric footwear is just that, right? Two different shoes.
Yet, for one of the senior character artists working on the Sims, competitor Paralives' support for non-uniform footwear signifies something much more significant.
Read more
articles.title: "I wish I could do that": A developer on The Sims has been eyeing up Paralives' characters' asymmetric shoes and their wider possibilities

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Nioh, far, wherever you are. I've probably made that bad pun before, but seriously, I hope our guides writer Jeremy's not close to any desks right now. Nioh 3, that game that pushed the poor bloke to the point of violence against the contents of his home, is getting its first major DLC next month. The expansion's dubbed Hell Rising, and kicks off a two-part story with a trip to a decimated version of Japanese capital Edo during the Keian era.
Read more
articles.title: Nioh 3's Hell Rising DLC will sword thrust the soulslike's yokai-battling action into decimated Keian era Edo when it arrives next month

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
I too often default to thinking of videogames as singular, monolithic things, rather than hives of collectively made functions and assets, secreted behind a launcher icon. Kaschei, an experimental visual novel created for Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2, is an openly piecemeal arrangement of mutually informing or sabotaging fictions, stretched across different interfaces and timeframes, held together by a lot of lovely and hateful emotions. A really good kind of carefully networked, absolute mess. People and pieces in orbit.
 
Read more
articles.title: Toxic yuri story Kaschei is a marvelous free visual novel that turns your Downloads folder into a little labyrinth of mirrors

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Civ 7's July update drops today, July 28th, delivering a handful of useful tweaks as devs Firaxis continue to build on their substantial revamp of the strategy game via its Test of Time update. This time around, adding more depth to interactions between the player and other civs is the focus, via changes to peace deals and leader relationship mechanics.
Read more
articles.title: Civilization 7's latest update adds more depth to peace deal brokerage and leader relations, as Firaxis gear up for "bigger additions"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Red Echoes: Berlin is a narrative-driven turn-based strategy game in which you join the German "November Revolution" across 1918 and 1919, during the final days of World War 1. Over the course of three chapters, you'll play as three budding agitators from different walks of life, rubbing shoulders with the likes of Karl Liebknecht and Rosa Luxemburg. You'll move your subversives around a beautiful Berlin map inspired by "classic Weimar-era graphic design", deploying their special abilities against the minions of the state.
 Read more
articles.title: Overthrow the Kaiser in Red Echoes: Berlin, a Weimar-era turn-based strategy game in the style of Suzerain

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Car Park Capital is a triumphantly unwholesome tycoon game in which you try to make an entire society utterly dependent on cars. You start with a relatively green-ish map, and do your best to tarmac it all over. A strange and unlikely prospect, I know!
When we first covered this motorist management sim last year, the options included putting up billboards to brainwash obstinate pedestrians, and selling people banana-mobiles. Since then, developer Hilko Janssen of Hilkojj Interactive has found a publisher in MicroProse. If you were hoping that MicroProse might persuade Janssen to give up on his visions of total automotive apocalypse, you were hoping in vain. 

 
Read more
articles.title: That evil Car Park Capital tycoon game is only getting more evil with MicroProse as publisher, but it still looks gorgeous

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Who knows when or if BioWare'll ever be allowed to make a follow-up to Dragon Age: The Veilguard. Whatever ends up being the future of a series EA've left in a rather ambiguous place, a group of Crusader Kings 3 modders have stepped up to make a Dragon Age total conversion that lets folks play out a bit of their own kingdom-battling history in Thedas.
Read more
articles.title: Dragon Age: Thedas at War is a BioWare RPG-inspired Crusader Kings 3 total conversion mod that's here to keep the series alive while it sits in EA limbo

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Released back in 2018, Crashphalt is a free and eccentric multiplayer game in which players do ground-pounds to send out seismic ripples, striving to punt each other off-screen. It's got an "overwhelmingly positive" Steam user review reception, as of writing, but that's not entirely a judgement on its quality. You see, Crashphalt is a hit today partly because you need it to run an online multiplayer mod for Toby Fox's wonderful RPG Undertale.
Of Crashphalt's 555 currently existing user reviews, the vast majority were written over five years after release, and either totally disregard or cruelly dunk on Crashphalt. An example: "10/10 Funny Undertale game, will never play this."
 Read more
articles.title: "I dunno why they chose Crashphalt": forgotten Steam game suddenly becomes a hit after players start using it for Undertale online multiplayer

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Grab your Geiger counter and your copy of The Arbinger Institute’s seminal conflict resolution handbook The Anatomy of Peace, because STALKER 2’s faction war-y story expansion Cost of Hope has a release date. It’s out on August 20th, developers GSC Game World have announced, and will launch in tandem with the long-awaited Update 2.0 – which, among other tweaks, will move the base game over to a newer, less technically perilous version of Unreal Engine 5.
Read more
articles.title: STALKER 2's Cost of Hope expansion, and its free but still hopeful 2.0 update, get an August release date

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
We famously love a bit of Myst here at RPS. Always have. So, naturally, Cyan Worlds deciding to bust out a teaser for a new game in the Mystverse that's since been cancelled caught our attention.
Read more
articles.title: Myst devs Cyan Worlds show off prototype for Project Anglerfish, a canned entry in the noted long-time RPS favourite series

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Hello all! Welcome to another week of sordid digital diversions, aka new PC games, dumped upon the innocent wanderer like a chamberpot upended over your head by a Victorian maid, as you saunter down an alleyway in your finest crinoline and lobster tail bustle. How are you supposed to attend the Crown Prince's soirée in this bedraggled state? In vain do you shake your reeking fists at the chambermaid, for she is a minion of the Maw, and only squawks with glee. You totter out of the alleyway, mopping your face with your nosegay, and are promptly arrested for being a public obscenity.
Enough of this pissy period palaver! Our list of the week's most promising new PC releases awaits. It's a longer edition, possibly because my laptop audio stopped working halfway through the curation process, so I may have included a few extra games that sound absolutely abysmal.
 Read more
articles.title: This week in PC games: a battle royale detective game, a broken Y2K metaverse, a laptop tycoon sim, and a new Company of Heroes RTS

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' pre-launch open beta has just wrapped up, having been open over the weekend. Sadly, those who've given the fighter a go on PC over the past few days have run into a litany of issues, leaving developers Arc System Works apologising for the inconvenience and scrambling to provide fixes.
Read more
articles.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls open beta beaten and bashed by PC performance issues, Arc System Works "apologise for the impact this has had on your experience"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Sundays are for sobbingly lifting exactly one boulder from the groaning dreampile that is my backlog. Good news, Vacuity, cpt_freakout and the rest – I'm trying out your precious, precious Troubleshooter game. I hear it's a hundred hours long, so please do not take this as a promise that a write-up is forthcoming. So far my major takeaways are 1) I enjoy collecting masteries, aka packages of abilities and modifiers, and 2) this "Short Break" track is cooool. Please hum along while browsing our latest collection of Rollicking Reads.
 Read more
articles.title: The Sunday Papers

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Video game cameras are often a point of contention primarily because a bad one can completely disorient you, or even outright make you feel sick. These are worthwhile things to consider, but I do wish there was more of a discussion around the specific choices that are made in particular camera angles and positions, and how it might actually be important that certain games should be played in the way they are designed. I'm going to throw all of that out of the window right now though and tell you about a Baldur's Gate 3 true third-person camera mod.
 
Read more
articles.title: Commit cinematic sacrilege in Baldur's Gate 3 with this true third-person camera mod

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
If we ignore the many, many negatives that came with the late 90s/early 2000s era of video marketing, there was a certain charm to the edginess that I kind of wish was still around in some ways. I say that because of a recently revealed immersive action horror shooter named Ringwyrm, that, were it to have released in that era, so easily could have had a tagline like, "The only time you'll be happy you've got Ringwyrm." Alas!
 
Read more
articles.title: Ringwyrm might have a nasty sounding name, but its action horror, fantasy Soviet vibes are too compelling to ignore

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Poor Thick as Thieves. When it was revealed over two years ago it had some promise, or at the very least an interesting mechanical premise in that it was a multiplayer immersive sim where everyone would be competing for the same loot. This got downgraded earlier this year ahead of its launch to just solo or co-op play, a real shame but hey ho, how many co-op imsims are there anyway? Sadly, the game has clearly not done well, as a number of layoffs have taken place at developer OtherSide Entertainment following its launch. But at the very least, what's left of the studio has some positive news: it won't become unplayable.
 
Read more
articles.title: Thick as Thieves studio does what triple-A won't: keep its game playable

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I don't see Sony going back on their plans to embrace a discless PlayStation future, but I do wonder if they realised just how many of us would continue to talk about it for as long as we have. Even RPS got involved, and us PC lot had to abandon discs a millenia ago! And now Sega, former physical media producers themselves, have wandered into the conversation, even throwing a bone to the computer preferring collective that we all are.
 
Read more
articles.title: Sega like physical games too, says their president, but with the shift to digital they're keeping the humble PC in mind

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Finally, a Final Fantasy 14 job made specifically for the type of person who likes to dual wield shields in Dark Souls! The latest FF14 fan festival is taking place, and with that has come a suite of announcements, including a reveal at one of the two new jobs coming as part of the next expansion, Evercold.
 
Read more
articles.title: Final Fantasy 14's Evercold expansion brings aboard a Final Fantasy 7 collab and a job that's all about fighting with massive shields

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
I spent most of last Saturday laid out in a Baku hotel room, muscles in both legs ground to flecks of useless meat by the decision to walk down a mountain when there was a perfectly good funicular right there. May this weekend be more fruitful, and less marred by the stupidity of trying to please a step counter that only truly cares about where its next battery charge is coming from. Ruinous silicone bastard.
Read more
articles.title: What are we all playing this weekend?

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
I've been vaguely looking forward to grotty dark fantasy RPG The Blood Of Dawnwalker, despite its genAI flirtations. To recap, it casts you as a medieval vampire fledgling whose family has been abducted by another, boss vampire. You've got 30 days and nights to save your loved ones while deciding just how much you're going to succumb to the gore-guzzling curse.
 Read more
articles.title: You can trade in your enemy's teeth to "bend" time in vampire RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker, care of some really horrible Tooth Fairies

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
World of Warcraft studio Blizzard have announced that they've fired a developer after development-only spells were used to insta-kill some Mythic+ dungeon bosses for a party of non-dev adventurers. The studio will also be "taking action against the player accounts that were complicit in this violation", which was unearthed by some combat log sleuths.
Read more
articles.title: Blizzard fire World Of Warcraft developer over use of forbidden magicks to insta-kill bosses for regular players during dungeon run

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
If the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike’s analogue clickers were all about fine-tuning the sensation at the very tips of your mousing fingers, the HyperX Pulsefire Saga is all about adjusting the parts nestled in the rest of your hand. To nowhere near the same extent, granted, but the Saga’s modular components – and the fact that it costs a fraction of what the X2 Superstrike does – make it appealing addition to your wired mouse options.
Read more
articles.title: HyperX Pulsefire Saga gaming mouse review: modular parts win hearts

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
I return to Project Zomboid exactly like an emaciated survivor crawling back to the undead-ridden town they abandoned many moons ago, having finally exhausted their wilderness stocks of cabbage and duct tape. I poke my head into the Steam forums as though cracking the door on a suspiciously silent mall.
 Read more
articles.title: 13 years on, unfinishable survival game Project Zomboid is getting a major update with an expanded Kentucky map, animal husbandry, and revised crafting

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Ah! You hadn't totally retreated from the battlefield following your cancellation in early 2025, Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition's Baltic Powers DLC! It was just one of your strategic tricks to lull your enemies into a false sense of security. Now, with the time finally being right, you've re-emerged to stake your claim on a September release.
Read more
articles.title: Surprise, Age of Empires 3: Definitive Edition's Baltic Powers expansion has re-emerged from the annals of cancelled DLC history, will come out in September

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
It is said that to name a wild thing is to tame it, to delimit and temper it, to defuse its menace. The giant, vaporous spider in Fallgrade is called Karl. Know any Karls? Are you a Karl? I wonder if it's Karl as in Karl Marx. Perhaps it's a reference to arachnid imagery in anti-Communist propaganda, though arachnid imagery isn't the exclusive preserve of anti-Communists.
Myself, I tend to associate the name "Karl" with paperweights, for reasons my brain refuses to explain to me. And yet, for all these steadying associations, Karl the spider still gives me the willies. Nothing tame about that thing at all.
 
Read more
articles.title: I enjoy Fallgrade's grainy physics-defying city almost as much as I fear its foggy giant spider

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
In hindsight, I was a fool for meeting Denshattack’s satirical, irreverent, downright countercultural sensibilities with surprise. Upbeat, even goofy as it is for a train driving game, it shares more common ground with skateboarding games, and while the commodification of skater culture is certainly A Thing, few skaters have ever reapplied their asphalt-eating skills to bootlicking.
What remains striking, though, is how specifically '2026' Denshattack's targets are. The main baddies are a rogue big tech company, deploying all your current favourite social ills: enforced inequality, mass surveillance, misinformation-spewing talking heads, police violence, and soulless AI replacing true craft and skill. If only it did a bit on mass layoffs, it would have had a full set. You meet them with force, too, assembling a crew that resembles a Greatest Hits of Japanese normbreaker groups while repeatedly ramming your engine through those oppressive mechanisms at top-gear Skinkansen speeds.
The result is that Denshattack manages to have it both ways, being fully capable of stretching a daft grin across your face, yet possessing a radical heart that wards off the sense – and, indeed, accusations – that this is just an ironic bit of comedy train capering. Yet according to David Jaumandreu, game director at developers Undercoders, Denshattack was never consciously given a political voice – it simply emerged, logically and naturally, from its Japan being shaped as a more locomotive-mad version of the real one.
Read more
articles.title: "Let's make a better world": Denshattack's developers on counterculture, biker gangs, and the optimism of fighting a mecha with a train

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Kingdom Come Deliverance developers Warhorse confirmed back in May that they've got a "new Kingdom Come adventure" in the works, alongside a Lord of the Rings RPG. The name of the former looks like it may now have been revealed via a freshly filed EU trademark for the phrase 'Kingdom Come Salvation'.
Read more
articles.title: Kingdom Come Salvation could be Warhorse's next medieval history RPG, if this EU trademark filing turns out to be the genuine article

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Perhaps predictably, Creative Assembly's Total War: Warhammer 40,000 could be quite the step change for how Total War handles ranged combat. Yesterday, the developers livestreamed a battle between the Imperium and the Orks, while chatting enthusiastically about the nuances of drop pods and flamers and evasion stats.


Like a gretchin war reporter – there are Ork journalists, right? Newswaaaagh? Gubbinzfeed? The Wall Street Choppa? – I've been running from foxhole to foxhole, jotting down notes. The conclusion I've come to is that the new strategy game could diverge quite significantly from the archers-behind-spearguys square dance of older Twars. Your units are more autonomous and also, more flexible and smarter in terms of who they shoot with what.
 
Read more
articles.title: Sweeping, strafing and suppression: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 threatens to blow up Total War's combat fundamentals

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' pre-launch open beta has opened its doors today, July 24th. It's set to run until July 27th, so offers a chance to end your week with some superhero graps prior to the game's full launch early next month. Meanwhile, Arc System Works have revealed the first fighter set to arrive as part of Fighting Souls year one batch of post-launch DLC in autumn. It's Phoenix Cyclops.
Read more
articles.title: Thwack, the Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls open beta is underway, and, pow, Phoenix Cyclops is coming as a post-launch DLC fighter

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Four years ago, a developer called Jean Nguyen shared a short video on Dwitter of a spinosaurus pulling off a sick combo with Cloud Strife's Buster Sword. This, of course, blew up, but it wasn't actually a game, just some animation work from the dev. And then, somewhere along the line, Nguyen decided to make it into an actual game. It's now called Dinoblade, it's out today, and it is jank and over top in exactly the right ways, and genuinely a rip roaring time.
 
Read more
articles.title: Dinoblade, out now, is equal parts janky, genuinely sick and silly as hell

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Sanctuary: Shattered Sun is the kind of unwholesomely large real-time strategy game where you keep accidentally auto-constructing 50 missile trucks because you were preoccupied with (e.g.) a massive spiderbot offensive on the other side of an ocean. Those things breed like rabbits! Still, easy come, easy go: simply charge your 50 superfluous missile trucks into the nearest line of energy domes, and watch as they, the enemy, and everybody we have ever loved disintegrates in about 20 seconds.
Shattered Sun does reward micromanagement – "every projectile is simulated", the devs proclaim, which means you can dance your tanks away from incoming shells – and also encourages resource efficiency, with a "flow-based economy" that hinges on access to generators and alloy extraction sites. But going by my hour with the demo, it more immediately rewards the act of scooping together a continent-sized deathball and rolling it through the nearest pocket of red on your map.
 Read more
articles.title: I've yet to smash open a Dyson Sphere in sci-fi RTS Sanctuary: Shattered Sun, but I'm enjoying its take on Supreme Commander

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
The $55 billion leveraged buyout which will see Saudi Arabia, Silver Lake and Jared Kushner-founded investment firm Affinity Partners become the new owners of EA has been given the thumbs up by the European Commission. The body have ruled that the acquisition's ok as far as the EU's rules on mergers go, and that it doesn't "raise competition concerns".
Read more
articles.title: Saudi Arabia's $55 billion EA buyout approved by the European Commission, who say it doesn't "raise competition concerns"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Excellent real-time castle defender Cataclismo is getting a DLC expansion, The Old Kingdom, which transforms it into a hex-based strategy boardgame. Players must hexpand from citadel to citadel, shoring up supply lines and unlocking technology while fending off the minions of the Mist. Please aim your Lobbers and Cannoneers at this trailer.
 Read more
articles.title: Terrific castle-building sim Cataclismo is being transformed into a chunky strategy boardgame, care of a paid Old Kingdom expansion

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
The recently formed Rockstar developer union - officially the Rockstar Games Workers Union - have had their first meeting with management at the GTA 6 maker, whom they're still seeking voluntary recognition from. The union, who're part of the wider Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB), have called this first meeting "a step in the right direction" and that they've secured "a roadmap for a speedy negotiation process".
Read more
articles.title: Rockstar Games Workers Union say their first meeting with the GTA 6 studio's management was "a step in the right direction"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Star Wars Zero Company is the XCOM-style tactics RPG in which you, a Clone Wars-era roughneck called Hawks, lead a squad of "unconventional professionals" into battle against some enigmatic threat to the galaxy. Among these unconventional professionals is a Jedi Padawan, Tel-Rea. Her moves include dual-wielding lightsabers and Force Pushing mooks into overwatch zones. What a beast! Be careful with your Tel-Rea, though: you only get one of her, and she's permakillable. There's no option to train up a replacement Jedi Padawan as a custom operator.
 Read more
articles.title: You only get one, permakillable Jedi Padawan in Star Wars Zero Company, but that's fine because I'm going to roll an R2-D2 deathsquad anyway

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
The machine before me looks like Frankenstein's homebrew version of Guess Who. Its main panel is composed of three rows of portraits. Some show men in 1930s suits, others women in flapper dresses, still more are simply blue people-shaped silhouettes. Below each portrait is a simple on/off switch. To the left of the portraits is a slide selector alongside a list of locations. Above that is a radio dial and filament lights indicating a current setting. At the bottom of the machine is a readout displaying a cryptic code '01-QU-1-11'. And, to the right, most enticing of all, is a big red lever.
It may not be much to look at, but calibrated correctly, this machine lets me hear the dead. It's a good thing, too, because there are plenty of corpses at Galley House.
Read more
articles.title: The Incident At Galley House review – an enthralling deduction game that can't escape the genre's classic problem

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
It's been just over a year since Oblivion Remastered got update 1.2, a patch aiming to improve its performance and fix a bunch of bugs that'd been floating around since release. Since that point, the Elder Scrolls 4 revamp's been without any major updates, despite problems persisting.
The good news, or potential good news, is that Bethesda have now confirmed that the game's Switch 2 port features "optimisations" they're hoping to bring to PC at some juncture.
Read more
articles.title: Oblivion Remastered's lengthy patch drought could end with its Switch 2 release, which Bethesda say includes "optimisations" they hope to bring to PC

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Entertaining open world satire Future? No Thanks! has been abruptly delayed by Steam content reviewers, due to the presence of multiple seconds of "untextured polygons depicting ass and boobs". In a statement, developer Paulo "Molleindustria" Pedercini reveals that Valve's moderation teams have had the game under review for "more than three weeks", but have yet to make a call. Steamworks documentation suggests that content review should take no more than seven business days.
 
Read more
articles.title: Indie open worlder Future? No Thanks! gets last minute delay after Steam content mods allegedly demand a "watch the sex scene" button

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Stalker 2 studio GSC Game World have refuted claims from their original founder Sergiy Grygorovych, who left GSC in 2023, that Xbox paid more than the game cost to make as part of an exclusivity deal for it.
Read more
articles.title: Stalker 2 studio founder's claims that Xbox paid more for exclusivity than the game cost to make "do not reflect the actual facts", according to GSC Game World

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
If I've learned anything from years of dark fantasy, it's that there's no force in this universe more terrible than a puny-looking girl with a kitchen knife. Just ask Katana Man, or the Queen of Hearts. Or the lolloping wolfbeast I've recently disembowelled in Rubinite, a pretty slick and engrossingly evil boss rush action game from Gameworks Ventures and Cup Dog Games, which is on sale today.
 Read more
articles.title: Blasphemous and Sekiro enjoyers may savour the boss rushing of Rubinite, a dark fantasy action RPG about a red-eyed murder princess

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
If there's anything I know about Steam users, it's that they bloody love that wishlist system. Hundreds, if not thousands of games, all plonked in a single list that we can pretend we'll go through eventually to pick out some corkers we know we'll love, even though we know we'll just play the same thing we always do because the exhaustion of daily life limits what we can take in? Bloody lovely that is! And now, we'll be able to organise that even further, as categories are being added in.
 
Read more
articles.title: Steam wishlists are getting categories, making it even easier to organise all those games you'll definitely buy next sale

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Last week, in the wake of yet another round of mass layoffs across the company, Xbox announced that Fallout 5 is in preproduction, Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters are coming, and that Obsidian are working on a new Fallout project. If you were to ignore the 1600 staffers laid off and the ongoing call for a boycott due to Microsoft providing AI tech to the Israeli military as it continues to bombard Gaza and kill Palestinians, this would possibly be welcome news. But to make matters worse, OneBGS, the Bethesda Game Studios Union, have claimed that on the same day this was announced, laid off workers at Bethesda Montreal were informed that they would "receive the smallest severance legally possible without bargaining with the union."
 
Read more
articles.title: Laid off Bethesda Montreal staff allegedly told they'd get "smallest severance legally possible" the same day as those Fallout announcements

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Ah, the Electronic Entertainment Expo, better known by many as Summer Game Fes-, wait, sorry, guess I've already moved on! Better known as E3, of course, the first of its kind showcase dedicated entirely to video games that died because it simply couldn't figure out how to live in the modern world (they probably should have asked Geoff). The whole thing ended with much more of a whimper than a bang, but once upon a time it was the place to have your game. And now, the Video Game History Foundation have revealed a new collection all about the event "like you've never seen it before," covering many years worth of a range of materials.
 
Read more
articles.title: The Video Game History Foundation's latest collection is a deep dive into E3 "like you've never seen it before"

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Waterparks have always felt like quite a strange concept to me in that the UK is small enough that you can just take a quick train ride and be at a beach within an hour or so, give or take. We do have them here, I've just had no reason to go one, and also the idea of having to be rescued from the inside of a slide due to getting stuck for one reason or another is a (I think rational) fear I've had since discovering them. Therefore, I'll take a pass on actually visiting one, but I won't say no to building my own in Aquapark Tycoon, a waterpark sim game that's out in early access today.
 
Read more
articles.title: Forgo visiting the real thing this summer and build the waterpark of your dreams in Aquapark Tycoon, now out in early access

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Following Microsoft's mass layoffs, The Elder Scrolls Online has ended up in a transitional period while remaining staff work to forge a path forwards. If you want evidence of effects the cuts are already starting to have on the MMO, look no further than its Crown Store.
Read more
articles.title: "The goal is to provide what we can": Elder Scrolls Online Crown Store undergoing changes due to "team bandwidth" in wake of Xbox layoffs

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced's an idyllic pirate adventure, especially given it trains its eye firmly on Edward Kenway's quest for booty. Naturally, Kenway hangs out with a bunch of real pirates from history throughout his time on the high seas, including the most famous one, Blackbeard. There's now a mod that'll let you play as the bearded buccaneer in Black Flag Resynced. So, here I am to point out a grisly reason you might not fancy getting too into roleplaying as Mr Edward Teach (or Mr Edward Thatch, depending on which accounts you believe).
Read more
articles.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced modders make Blackbeard playable, but here's a syringe-shaped reason to avoid historically accurate pirate roleplay

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Frosthaven, and Gloomhaven before it, are complex turn-based tactical boardgames. Filled with cards, plastic figurines, a dense rulebook, and a denser tome filled with scenario descriptions and special conditions, Frosthaven's box comes to a weighty 36Ibs, or, in old money, 5Ibs heavier than the Lego Titanic.
One of the perks of the digital adaptations is that you don't need to lug around the equivalent of a four-year-old child to go play at being an RPG adventurer in a frozen wasteland with your mates, you can just boot it up and all hop into a multiplayer server together. Turns, too, play out faster, as you don't need to calculate all the enemy actions and slide their little plastic figurines to their new spots on the board. The digital adaptations reduce this down to a few neatly animated seconds of action. Though, that doesn't mean the rules themselves are any less simple. Nic (RPS in peace) spent a good chunk of his glowing Gloomhaven review just breaking down everything you need to do in a turn. So, understandably, Frosthaven can be difficult for new players to pick up.
However, it's actually the boardgame players trying out Snapshot Games' digital adaptation that are causing more of an issue.
Read more
articles.title: Dear Frosthaven boardgame players complaining the PC tactics RPG adaptation is bugged: the devs say it's likely you've "played it wrong"

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
While it’s not a series of truly Hitman-scale murder sandboxes, 007 First Light does make good on its promise of enabling multiple Bond, James Bonding disciplines: shooting, sneaking, punching, and my personal favourite, getting immediately discovered then bullshitting something about being a door technician for supervillain lairs. But, were it not for some rejigging work on IO Interactive’s part, First Light might well have ended up with an undue preference for the brawling, bloody, Daniel-Craig-in-a-bathroom approach.
That’s according to senior combat designer Tom Marcham, whom I briefly interrogated at a taping of the UKIE’s For One Night Only showcase. Marcham says that although there “was always the idea that [First Light] was going to be this kind of flexible blend” of secret agent styles, in the crucible of active development, the strength of straight up henchman-punching repeatedly threatened to wallop the stealth and social aspects into irrelevance.
Read more
articles.title: "It started to feel like there wasn't any stealth": 007 First Light had to pull Bond's punches to protect IO Interactive's specialty sneaking

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Duh, duh, duh. Duh, duh, de-duh. Duh, duh, duh. Duh, duh. That's how the riff to Deep Purple's tune about a fire burning down a Swiss casino goes. As with any riff, it's just a sequence of inputs you make on your instrument of choice. Usually, this would be a guitar. I've been trying to use the cat piano and singing gnome of jobbing composer sim Offbeat, which is out in early access today, July 22nd. Sadly, I don't think I've cracked it, but I have been having plenty of fun making funky jingles and wedding tunes.
Read more
articles.title: Playing the riff from Smoke on the Water on a cat piano may be possible in composer sim Offbeat, if you've got more musical talent than me

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Hasbro, parent company of Baldur's Gate IP holders Wizards of the Coast and backer of Exodus developers Archetype Entertainment, have announced a $56 million impairment as part of their latest financial results. This recording of assets decreasing in value compared to their theoretical worth is tied to the company having cancelled "several games scheduled for release in 2028 and beyond". That leaves Hasbro's games lineup thinner going forwards, but with releases targeting 2027, like Exodus and Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, still on the way.
Read more
articles.title: Baldur's Gate series overlords Hasbro take $56 million hit after cancelling several games due out in "2028 and beyond", with Exodus and Warlock unaffected

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Occasionally I will see a game that opts for an artstyle so complex and involved that will clearly take years to make, leaving me with an unbridled fear of the gamey part being not very good. I'm talking about games like Harold Halibut, where the entire thing is stop-motion. Do you know how long stop-motion takes! A while, I've heard. I feel similarly about Scarlet Deer Inn, a Slavic-folklore inspired platformer where every single sprite is made from embroidery that's out today.
 
Read more
articles.title: Scarlet Deer Inn, out now, is a Slavic folk tale platformer with a dark underbelly where every sprite is physically embroidered

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
The idea of developing sound and well placed infrastructure in a contemporary city fills me with an overwhelming sense of incompetency, so for the most part I tend to steer clear of city builders of that ilk. I don't want to care about where a hospital needs to go, or how many roads is too many! So something like Thveit, a Norse folklore inspired city builder where the changing seasons shape how your villagers work, seems a bit more my speed.
 
Read more
articles.title: Thveit is a Norse citybuilder filled with folklore creatures where the changing seasons shape how you develop your village

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Things are sounding bad over at Splitgate developer 1047 Games once again. After launching Empulse last month, a wall-running, quite Titanfall-esque FPS with mechs game that James had some fun with, it appears that layoffs have taken place at the studio, marking the third round of them in the space of about a year.
 
Read more
articles.title: Less than a month after launching Empulse, it looks like Splitgate dev 1047 Games are laying off more staff

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I'm sure there's plenty enough of you that moved on from the first Darkest Dungeon onto the second one when that launched in 2023, but guess what! You'll have an opportunity to revisit the original turn-based dungeon crawler next month, as developer Red Hook Studios have announced its first bit of DLC since 2020 in commemoration of the game's 1.0 launch 10th anniversary.
 
Read more
articles.title: Darkest Dungeon is getting its first new bit of DLC in six years, borrowing a couple of classes from its sequel

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Anyone who knows me knows that the one frustration I come back to in games, above all else, more than yellow paint, quest markers and horrendously written dialogue, is that there just isn't enough cow breeding. Where is it? The video game industry is sorely lacking in that department, but fear not fellow freaks, Manor Lords has our back, as by the end of the month you'll be able to breed your cattle to your hearts' content.
 
Read more
articles.title: Manor Lords' next beta update adds what all video games are sorely missing: cow breeding

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Look at the nice fellow in the featured image of this article. Look into his eyes. Look at the slightly awkward grin plastered across his face at the moment in a YouTube video on his channel that I've chosen to pause and take a screenshot. This is a man who wants you to feel "a sense of agony". To be frustrated and perplexed as to which outcome to choose. This is a man who knows you can't feed the world with a set of laser eyeballs. This is Fallout: New Vegas director Josh Sawyer, who recently made some points about RPG building that are worth dissecting in light of his reported new gig as head of Obsidian's upcoming Fallout game.
Read more
articles.title: Reported lead of Obsidian's new Fallout game wants you to feel a "sense of agony" when playing an RPG, rather than being an all-powerful god-splatterer

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
A day will dawn when the premise "what if Darkest Dungeon but also XYZ" will lose its crablike stranglehold on my fancy, but that day is not this day, for today we Dive or Die. Not that the two activities are mutually exclusive. 
In this 2D roguelite scuba sim from Drop Rate Studio and publishers Dear Villagers, the world has succumbed to a "black rain" that inflicts mutations and nightmares. It's been chucking it down for five solid years, in fact, with human civilisation reduced to scraping a living on mountaintops that are now islands. There isn't much of a living to scrape on mountaintops, so off you go into the "abyssal pool" to dredge up some canned food and building materials.
 Read more
articles.title: Out today, Dive or Die is a promising roguelite scuba sim that basically turns Darkest Dungeon into Ecco the Dolphin

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
"Wreckreation wasn’t actually an attempt to recreate Burnout," former Criterion Games studio head Fiona Sperry says as she and her team reveal their latest arcade racer, Wreckreation 2. "I think some people thought it was. But it was actually an exploration of freedom and creativity in racing games, and that was really a continuation of unfinished work at the end of [Burnout] Paradise and also the game we were making before we left EA. It was really about asking the question, ‘What if we gave players an enormous amount of freedom?’"
Read more
articles.title: Building on Burnout and an underwhelming predecessor are Wreckreation 2’s missions, and so far it’s a promising patch of Paradise

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Future? No Thanks! is a jolly and acerbic open world city game from seasoned satirist Paulo "Molleindustria" Perdicini. It's about a bitter old boomer trying to enjoy his final day in an ecosocialist paradise. There's a demo on Steam that gives you 30 minutes access to a realm of sentient toilets, cricket burgers, ornamental park guillotines, and cannabis vending machines. Speaking as a bitter old millennial, I found my 30 minutes delightful.

 
Read more
articles.title: "Enjoy your last day in a future that works for everyone but you": I adore the demo for Future? No Thanks, an open world comedy about a boomer trapped in leftwing paradise

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Forza Horizon 5 creative director Mike Brown, who's currently working on open-world racer Clutch after departing Microsoft-owned Playground Games in 2023, has offered his perspective on Xbox's current layoff-heavy pivot in direction. Despite the Xbox Game Pass push of former Xbox boss Phil Spencer and co being blamed by new boss Asha Sharma as she's ditched studios and given devs their walking papers, Brown still believes Game Pass was a "good" concept, if clearly not one successful enough to avoid this outcome.
Read more
articles.title: "The concept of [Xbox] Game Pass was good" despite its eventual faceplant now contributing to mass job losses, reckons Forza Horizon 5 director

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, this year's Activision shooter about military markspeople (who occasionally look like Beavis and Butt-Head) sliding around with SMGs and shouting 10-4 after checking their corners, is set for pre-release beta testing in August. There are two playtests currently on the calendar, though the first's exclusive to those who pre-order the game.
Read more
articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's open beta is set for next month, and will offer a chance to take on the fearsome new slaying slab mode

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Monika Kutějová)
articles.description: V tomto vydání Postřehů se podíváme na AI model, který si sám nahrál malware na PyPI, na severokorejské útoky na npm balíčky, kritické díry ve VMware, ruský zero-day v Outlooku a únik dat u Coca-Coly.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: když AI model sám zaútočí a nahraje malware na PyPI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Společnost Canonical představila Enterprise Store, nové řešení dostupné v rámci předplatného Ubuntu Pro. Experimentální systém XIOS přináší unixová desktopová prostředí na mobilní platformu firmy Apple.
articles.title: Canonical představil Enterprise Store, GNOME a KDE spustíte na iPadu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v GNOME #260 přináší zmrazení GNOME 51 a opět Glycin, týden v KDE a nejen Emoji Resizing, jádro Linux 7.2-rc6 řešící chod chybových SATA disků od WD, openSIL+Coreboot firmware od 3mdeb pro MSI PRO B850-P WIFI.
articles.title: KDE rychlejší s externími GPU, GNOME Glycin s úpravou pro Inkscape

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Patche pro AMD „Low Power“ CPU jádra včas pro Linux 7.3, spousta oprav pro AMDGPU a AMDKFD, podpora DRM format modifiers pro staré Radeony generací GCN 1.0 až 3.0, Peak Bandwidth Threshold pro Intel Xe3 / Panther Lake (a novější).
articles.title: Jádro Linux přinese vylepšení pro stařičké Radeony, efektivnější běh Intel Xe3

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Na předchozí dvě části seriálu o tvorbě aplikací pro počítače Atari dnes navážeme. Popíšeme si totiž CIO, což je součást vestavěného operačního systému umožňující provádění I/O operací s různými zařízeními.
articles.title: Podpora unifikované práce se zařízeními v operačním systému Atari: CIO

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes vyzkoušíme jednu týmovou platformu, podíváme se na moderní Wayland kompozitor, přehrajeme si hudbu přímo ze struktury složek a podíváme se klienta pro síť MeshCore.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (29. 7. 2026): spojte komunikaci, správu projektů a AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ukážeme si, jakým způsobem lze otevřít okno a přes knihovnu gg provést vykreslení celé 2D scény do plochy tohoto okna. Následně přidáme interaktivní ovládání aplikace pomocí klávesnice i myši.
articles.title: Tvorba interaktivních aplikací s GUI s využitím projektu GoGPU

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: V dnešním díle se podíváme na úspěšný vishing útok na českou organizaci, dálkový ovladač na elektrickou síť, další malware využívající AI a GPT uniklé z dětské ohrádky.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: AI jako pomocník, záškodník i dobrodruh

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: FreeBSD odstranilo ze svého základního kódu poslední zbytky kódu pod licencí GNU GPL. Operační systém Haiku portuje monitor virtuálních strojů z NetBSD. Nadace UBports vydala dlouho očekávanou aktualizaci Ubuntu Touch OTA-2.0.
articles.title: FreeBSD odstranilo kód pod GNU GPL, Haiku portuje NVMM

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v KDE a nejen automatické zamknutí RDP sezení při ztrátě připojení, týden v GNOME a opět Sophie s Loupe + Glycin či applovské menu Kiwi, vývojová verze Wine 11.14 a konverze 7.1 zvuku.
articles.title: Vylepšení pro knihovnu Glycin a cenzura PDF pro GNOME, Wine řeší nejen běh Hedgewars

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt NetBSD oznámil vydání operačního systému NetBSD 11.0. Jde o první stabilní vydání, které zahrnuje podporu 64bitové architektury RISC-V, včetně řady zařízení založených na čipech StarFive JH71XX, jako jsou VisionFive 2, PINE64 STAR64 a také emulátoru QEMU.
articles.title: NetBSD 11.0 přináší podporu RISC-V a malé jádro pro rychlý start

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vlastní Cestou)
articles.description: Skupina Cl0p patří k ransomwarovým gangům, které si systematicky vybírají velké organizace a jejich dodavatelské řetězce. V posledních letech opakovaně zneužila zranitelnosti v platformách pro přenos souborů (MFT), jako byly GoAnywhere MFT a MOVEit Transfer, kde jí stačil jeden průnik do centrální služby, aby získala data stovek zákazníků. Typický scénář je pořád stejný: tiché získání dat, následné zveřejnění obětí a nátlak na zaplacení výkupného.
articles.title: Cl0p zneužívá opět hromadné krádeže dat, útoky míří na velké firmy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: AUR (Arch Linux User Repository) má od června problémy s malwarem a asi to stále nekončí. Objevila se nová vlna útoku, která si vynutila dočasný zákaz adopce balíčků.
articles.title: AUR opět s malware, zákaz adopce balíčků

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Případ začal v roce 2018, 12letá dívka z USA si psala přes aplikaci Kik s uživatelem fus__ro_dah (dvě podtržítka). Její matka při kontrole telefonu objevila nevhodné fotografie muže a věc oznámila policii. Ta zabavila mobilní telefon a objevila 125 zpráv od uživatele fus__ro_dah. Poslali proto soudní příkaz společnosti Kik, aby zjistili identitu tohoto uživatele, nicméně v příkazu napsali fus_ro_dah (jedno podtržítko).
articles.title: Kanaďan odsouzen na 18 měsíců kvůli chybějícímu podtržítku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Alois Sečkár)
articles.description: Prahu čeká 29. září již třetí ročník mezinárodní konference pro příznivce frontendového open-source frameworku Vue.js. Letošní PragVue 2026 proběhne v Karlíně v prostorách oceňované irské restaurace Arthur's Pub.
articles.title: Konference PragVue letos v září už potřetí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Fedora navrhovala použít Shadow Stack jako výchozí již v letošním vydání verze 45. Shadow Stack je bezpečnostní funkce dostupná na procesorech Intel 11. generace  nebo AMD Zen 3 a novější a chrání návratové adresy například před útoky typu přetečení zásobníku. Kvůli Shadow Stack byla také do Glibc přidána podpora pro konfiguraci pomocí souboru  /etc/tunable.conf.
articles.title: Shadow Stack bude až ve Fedoře 46

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Docker je dnes technologie, která proces vývoje, testování a provozování softwaru velmi zjednodušuje. Provozujte cokoliv a kdekoliv. Už nečekejte na nastavení svého serveru nebo na aktualizaci nějaké knihovny. Mějte prostředí jako součást vaší aplikace.
articles.title: Naučte se pracovat s Dockerem a kontejnery (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Jak jsme již informovali, LLM OpenAI v polovině července unikl ze sandboxu a napadl Hugging Face. Problému si nejdříve všiml Hugging Face a asi až za týden samotný OpenAI.
articles.title: Anthtropic Claude také hackoval tři organizace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři Debianu začali před několika dny projednávat obsah obecného usnesení týkajícího se využívání velkých jazykových modelů (LLM) v rámci projektu Debian. V současné době zvažují pět různých variant toho, jak by bylo možné povolit či zakázat využívání umělé inteligence v prostředí Debianu.
articles.title: Debian pokračuje v diskusi o přístupu k AI, na stole je návrh s pěti variantami

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt OpenWrt vydal verzi 24.10.8, která řeší kritickou chybu přetečení zásobníku v protokolu DHCPv6 a širší sadu chyb ve výchozích povolených síťových službách, které lze zneužít na dálku. Kritická chyba  CVE-2026–53921 je ohodnocená skóre 9,8 a umožňuje neautentizovanému útočníkovi, který má přístup k serveru DHCPv6, přepsat vyrovnávací paměť v odhcpd pomocí speciálně upraveného požadavku DHCPv6 REQUEST.
articles.title: Kritická chyba v OpenWrt DHCPv6 umožňuje vzdálené spuštění kódu pod rootem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Na kyberzločineckém fóru Altenen se šíří 17GB databáze, o které autor tvrdí, že byla získána ze služby SplitVPN, dříve známé jako NotVPN. Jde o ruskou VPN určenou k obcházení internetové cenzury. Zřejmě sice nedošlo k úniku úplných čísel platebních karet, byly však odhaleny e-mailové adresy, IP adresy, identifikátory zařízení, přibližná poloha, stav předplatného a tokeny pro opakované platby.
articles.title: Únik dat z VPN odhalil miliony záznamů o spojení, firma slibovala neuchovávání informací

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Broadcom vydala bezpečnostní aktualizace, které řeší několik bezpečnostních chyb ovlivňujících produkty VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation a Fusion, přičemž tři z nich byly klasifikovány jako kritické.
articles.title: Tři chyby ve VMware umožňují obejít ověření, spustit kód a uniknout z virtualizace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Řídicí výbor GCC oznámil, že přijal zásady pro příspěvky v oblasti umělé inteligence, které doporučila pracovní skupina GCC pro politiku v oblasti umělé inteligence. Očekáváme, že se tato politika bude i nadále vyvíjet, a budeme ji pravidelně přezkoumávat, píše v oznámení David Edelsohn.
articles.title: GCC oznamuje strategii v oblasti umělé inteligence

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Gitea opravila kritickou bezpečnostní chybu umožňující vzdálené spuštění kódu. Uživatel s běžným přístupem pro zápis do repozitáře může obsah úpravy ovládané útočníkem přeměnit na aktivní gitovský hook a spouštět příkazy shellu pod účtem, pod kterým služba Gitea běží.
articles.title: Gitea má vážnou bezpečnostní chybu umožňující vzdálené spuštění shellových příkazů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Dostat linuxový ovladač pro Radeony a API Vulkan na platformu Windows jako funkční řešení je dalším cílem Valve. Firma, která toho pro hraní na Linuxu udělala patrně více než kdokoli jiný, tak pokračuje (to je moje domněnka) ve svém tažení proti dominanci Windows pro hraní her, resp. proti nutnosti pro takovou činnost vůbec Windows mít.
articles.title: Valve sponzoruje vývoj RADV pro Windows

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Máme tu další den a s ním další díl mýdlové opery na téma „Co vše lze vytvořit s pomocí AI“. Dnešní epizoda se jmenuje Starling a jde o ve Swiftu napsaný jednoduchý desktop, vlastní Wayland kompozitor, to vše s pomocí AI.
articles.title: Starling, desktop i Wayland kompozitor napsaný pomocí AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Takto vypadá ideální podpora hardwaru na Linuxu. Společnost Arctic uvedla na trh nový kontrolér pro ovládání ventilátorů a rovnou ode dne uvedení má produkt podporu v Linuxu. Tuto podporu připravili vývojáři Arcticu. Vyřešena tím je i jedna malá hádanka.
articles.title: Nový Fan Controller od Arctic rovnou i s podporou Linuxu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Nginx je dnes přibližně na třetině web serverů na internetu a toto číslo stále roste. Je výkonný, spolehlivý, má spoustu funkcí a dobře se spravuje. Pokud potřebujete dobrý web server pro svůj projekt, bude Nginx správnou volbou.
articles.title: Nasaďte moderní web server s Nginx (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Sada nových patchů pro p-state ovladač procesorů AMD potěší všechny hráče, tedy zejména také majitele strojků Steam Deck. Implementace per-core Energy Performance Preference (EPP) boostu pro aktuálně zatížená CPU jádra totiž zvyšuje hodnotu fps pro nejnižší 1 %, tedy pro klíčovou metriku, která často rozhoduje o vnímání plynulosti běhu hry. Nárůst může být na Steam Decku až téměř třetinový.
articles.title: Patche pro AMD P-State mohou zvýšit 1%-Low fps ve hrách až o 31%

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Organizace Iuridicum Remedium oznámila, že zemřel Ondrej Mikle. V internetové komunitě byl známým bezpečnostním expertem, který se zabýval kryptografickými algoritmy, hardwarovou bezpečností, síťovými prvky a internetovými svobodami. Znali jsme se mnoho let, o těchto svých tématech také psal články pro Root.cz.
articles.title: Zemřel Ondrej Mikle, matfyzák, zastánce svobod a autor článků na Root.cz

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Šrámek)
articles.description: Picogame je open source 2D herní engine pro CircuitPython od Vladimíra Smitky (MakerClassCZ). Umožňuje jednoduše vytvořit vlastní hru na mikrokontrolérech jako jsou RP2040/RP2350 nebo ESP32 – například na české konzoli PicoPad.
articles.title: Český 2D herní engine pro CircuitPython s podporou řady mikrokontrolérů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Linux Vendor Firmware Service (LVFS) má novou verzi 2.1.7 aktualizačního nástroje Fwupd. Ta přidává podporu zařízení typu PixArt PJP360, pro touchpad PixArt POCO 103X. Jde o aktualizaci již existujícího pluginu o tuto novější verzi. Postarala se o ni sama společnost PixArt.
articles.title: Fwupd 2.1.7 přináší spoustu oprav

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nvidia oznamuje založení Open Secure AI Alliance, s desítkami partnerů z řad velkých jmen mezi IT a AI společnostmi. Členy jsou například Adobe, Cadence, Cisco, Cloudflare, Dell, HPE, IBM, The Linux Foundation, Microsoft, Palantir, Red Hat, SAP, Siemens, SK Telecom, SpaceX a další.
articles.title: Desítky firem zakládají Open Secure AI Alliance, incident s Hugging Face ukázal hrozbu nového typu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Google minulý čtvrtek oznámil, že zavádí jako další možnost přihlášení k účtu pomocí selfie. To má pomoci v případě, že jste například zapomněli heslo k účtu nebo při ztrátě telefonu. Ve skutečnosti nejde jen o jednu fotografii, ale o video. Google vás instruuje, abyste hlavou hýbali podle pokynů. To má zabránit podvrhům například s vytištěnou fotografií nebo s AI.
articles.title: Google zavádí přihlášení pomocí selfie

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Knihovna Glibc vyšla v sobotu ve verzi 2.44. Hlavní změnou je nový způsob konfigurace Glibc pomocí souboru /etc/tunables.conf, jak bylo nedávno navrženo Red Hatem. Tento soubor nahrazuje doposud používanou proměnnou GLIBC_TUNABLES a zároveň je univerzálnější.
articles.title: Vyšla knihovna Glibc 2.44 s /etc/tunables.conf

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: ADATA SC750: Výkonný SSD disk s rozměry flashdisku. Zasloužený klid na dovolené: Cloudová správa Nebula řeší dohled nad firemní sítí. Největší změna spisové služby za 20 let: odklad legislativy není důvod zastavit modernizaci. Čína podle zdrojů zahájila výrobu zařízení pro domácí produkci vyspělých čipů. Apple se stal druhou firmou, jejíž tržní hodnota přesáhla 5 bilionů dolarů. Neočekávaná magnetická odezva v atomových kontaktech ze zlata a stříbra je v rozporu s dosavadní teorií. Fortinet rozšiřuje řešení FortiEndpoint o nové funkce pro éru AI.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Čína podle zdrojů zahájila výrobu zařízení pro domácí produkci vyspělých čipů

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Umělá inteligence snadno vidí mimozemšťany i tam, kde nejsou. Navrhujeme umělý život. Objevena nejslabší planeta, jaká byla kdy ze Země vyfotografována. Vědci naučili AI vidět detaily za hranicí možností běžných optických přístrojů.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: První kvantový počítač v Česku se otevírá uživatelům

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 31/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Téměř 8 tisíc obětí ransomwaru za rok 2025: kvantoví útočníci sbírají šifrovaná data už dnes. Za 6 let se počet satelitů zečtyřnásobil. Autonomní agent AI se při bezpečnostním testu vymkl kontrole, uvedla OpenAI. Akt o kybernetické odolnosti: první povinnosti za dveřmi. O čipy je mezi studenty stále větší zájem. Pomáhá mezinárodní spolupráce i propojení s průmyslem. Kvůli klimatickým rizikům je ohrožena více než polovina finanční hodnoty evropských datových center pro AI.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Kvůli klimatickým rizikům je ohrožena více než polovina finanční hodnoty evropských datových center pro AI
